svg.desc: ASCII portrait of Jhonty Barreto beside a terminal-style profile. Co-founder of SEO Engico, mechanical engineer, B2B SEO and link building measured on revenue. 65,904 links placed by hand, 190+ clients, 94% of links still live at twelve months. Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Turso, Stripe, Cloudflare, Claude API.
